annotations.title: Free times for a call with Mike Fluff

description: List the open 30-minute slots for a free video call with Mike Fluff (business diagnosis, AI automation, compliance, Architect Mode), as ISO 8601 UTC start times. Use before book_call; pass one of these exact values as its "slot". Read-only.

days.description: How many days to cover from "from". Default 7, at most 21.

from.description: Earliest day to list, ISO date or date-time (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to now.

locale.description: Language for the booking page URL. Default en.
